title: *NEW*🔥📚 A Book Club For Curious Minds
description: 💌 **JOIN our NEW SUBSTACK to read ALL the book summaries 📕👇** https://rubyrossini.substack.com/ If you have not yet read the book, you are still very welcome to join us. However, in the case of reading a novel, reading it beforehand is strongly encouraged — both to deepen your own experience and to enrich the conversation for others. Regardless of whether you have read the book, take the time to go through the summary ( it will be published on Substack a few days before our event ) - it will help to ground the conversation on an even level for everyone on Saturday. It is not AI-written - I write all summaries & think pieces myself, and I aim to make them as in-depth as I possibly can. **For Announcements** **Join our WhatsApp Group.** I will announce here any new events and share the summary for those who are not on Substack: [https://chat.whatsapp.com/G011Ugv9bah08PYlcQFJ4m](https://chat.whatsapp.com/G011Ugv9bah08PYlcQFJ4m) ( This is the announcement group only - **ONLY once you have attended** the event, you'll be able to join *the other group,* which is for the community) ⛔️ **No Show** Don't be a 💩. Our waitlist is usually chunky. If you can’t make it, **change your RSVP,** it only takes a second. Two consecutive no-shows and you will be removed from future signups. **Book of the Month** In our last chapter, we followed Masha and Sergey through the various stages of romantic life: infatuation, projection, disillusionment, and, perhaps, acceptance. *Family Happiness* leaves us with an unsettling question: does Sergey abandon hope, abandon self-deception, or, more simply, has he learned to avoid one of the deepest wounds available to us: rejection? Few experiences wound us more deeply than being rejected by someone whose attention, admiration, or love we desire. And so, we leap from nineteenth-century Russia to the chronically online loneliness of the twenty-first century with *Rejection* by Tony Tulathimutte. This book is likely unlike anything you have read before: Hailed as one of the most provocative books of recent years, *Rejection* has been described by critics as "perversely funny and piercingly perceptive", "one of the boldest works in recent memory", and even as reading "like being inside the internet". Through a cast of lonely, self-sabotaging, and often deeply unlikeable characters, Tony Tulathimutte explores rejection, resentment, shame, and the desperate human need to be *wanted*. Darkly comic and painfully recognisable, the seven connected stories seamlessly transition between the personal crises of a complex ensemble and the comic tragedies of sex, relationships, identity, and the tragedies of the internet. Incels, tech bros, identity politics: nothing and no one is spared. Funny, dark, bold, explicit, genre-bending: “It’s the funniest, darkest thing—it’s like Dostoevsky’s *Notes from Underground* meets Instagram.” — St Vincent “Tulathimutte’s unnerving depiction of angry losers in these interconnected stories is hard to look away from.” — *Vulture* "The funniest book I've ever read." — Bowen Yang "I could compare *Rejection* to the work of Nabokov, in its stylish and blazingly original skewering of convention." — Vauhini Vara “The closest thing to reading David Foster Wallace I’ve encountered.” — Chris Hayes If you have a problem getting yourself a copy of the book/s, get in touch! **Make a commitment** 👏 [📅](https://emojipedia.org/calendar) As the spots fill up pretty quickly, be quick to sign up - but do so **ONLY if you make a real commitment to join.** We have an amazing, committed community that generously shows up, contributes, and gives its best. Sign up only if you are committed and eager to attend. **Mark your calendar** and make a commitment to yourself and your community. **Discussion** For the discussion, we’ll divide in smaller groups of around 4-6 as to have a more intimate environment to facilitate conversations where everyone can feel welcome to participate at their pace. **About Us** Welcome to "Curious Collective" – A Book Club for Curious Minds. If you find yourself here, chance is, you are curious. You are a wanderer, an explorer of ideas, seeking the 'whys' and 'hows' of our world, of what makes us human. In a culture dominated by “hyper-connectivity”, we often lose sight of what truly matters; the treasure of ancient wisdom, the beauty of curiosity, and the profound meaning of community. The Curious Collective is here to rekindle those flames. 🔥 We believe in the power of shared ideas, meaningful conversations, and sharing the journey. As Joseph Addison wisely said, "Reading is to the mind what exercise is to the body." Our collective mission is to exercise our minds, curiosity, and sense of belonging to a community of like-minded people. **We are not:** Intellectual W\*nkers or debate-club warriors here. We keep it real, there is no intellectual or self-righteous snobbery here. **We are:** Ordinary humans who crave knowledge, connection—someone to chat with, share ideas, and journey alongside. **Tips:** I suggest having a notebook/ a place where you can take notes of the most interesting parts & thoughts you had - this is going to be very helpful for the discussion. Stay Curious – for there's always more to discover.

title: Open Coffee Lisbon #51 - at Defuse Cafe
description: **Venue change = Defuse Cafe** Open Coffee Lisbon is a friendly informal networking event for entrepreneurs, professionals, locals, guests, people in the startup community, and students in Lisbon.⁣ Your host for our event will be Richard. with support from the Open Coffee Lisbon team. You may find a mentor, investor, client, co founder, employer, vendor, inspiration or a friend. Please post your contact details, a link to your Linkedin and/webpage in this group chat, and in our WhatsApp group [here ](https://chat.whatsapp.com/HZNea7wHN0093bOylglaKY)https://chat.whatsapp.com/HZNea7wHN0093bOylglaKY We start at 09:30 AM sharp. Everybody gets up to 2 minutes to present: 1. Who they are and what they are doing 2. What they want 3. How they can help others At 10:30 AM we stop hosting and you can talk to people who are most interesting to you. We are focused on business and social entrepreneurs, the startup community and anyone else who is doing something interesting or wants to get involved in other people's projects. You can talk about any project/topic. Open Coffee Lisbon is an “un-meeting” without a speaker or agenda. We are focused on attendees gaining value from other attendees. The rules, tools, structure and moderation aim to facilitate this goal. ⁣⁣What is the BIG idea behind Open Coffee? We want to help people create useful business connections.⁣ Everyone is welcome to our meetings, and we especially love first-timers.⁣ ⁣We want to make sure that if somebody coming from an unsupportive background/country has the courage to join, they will notice that we are glad they came because we welcome them. If you feel shy, you can also just listen but we encourage you to talk. Each attendee can also get to show their LinkedIn page or website through our channels and showcase their idea.⁣ This event is based on the Open Coffee Krakow format, run by Richard Lucas and others in Krakow Poland since 2012. If you want to help and get involved in making this gathering a regular part of the Lisbon eco-system please let us know [here](https://forms.gle/hjQUMyFap5K8yo8y9) https://forms.gle/hjQUMyFap5K8yo8y9 if you are interested in knowing more about the Open Coffee format, take a look at our video for potential leaders [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z99E2z8anFU). We have events in Cambridge, Krakow, Ericeira, Sydney, Warsaw and soon Tirana according to our format, When you sign up to our events we add you to our [mailing list](https://lisboncommunityevents.substack.com/) https://lisboncommunityevents.substack.com so we can tell you about more free events run by volunteers . If you don't want us to do that don't give us your email. If you change your mind you can leave the Substack mailing list at any time. Big thanks to Igor, Yan, and Brandon and the team at [Defuse Cafe](https://www.defusecafe.com/)[.](https://www.hood.pt) for providing the venue, and opening early for us. We are partnering with Ricardo and Anna of [Livfest](https://luma.com/livfest) for new event formats..
